name: Ranzaki Reika
source:
Grade: High school 2nd grader.
Room: Megae Dorm, Room 302.
Characteristic: Reika is mature by nature, and is aware of her attractiveness. She tends to be troublesome and hates it when she's not the center of everyone's attention. Her hobby is taking a bath.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080331225921/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/kid/game/game_galkid/milky/chara.html]official site[/url].]
